summary.one_liner: MIT OpenCourseWare page for the Fall 2010 course 6.034 Artificial Intelligence, covering knowledge representation, problem solving, and learning methods.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes the Fall 2010 MIT course 6.034 Artificial Intelligence, which introduces basic knowledge representation, problem solving, and learning methods. The course aims to teach students to build intelligent systems by assembling solutions to computational problems, and to understand the role of representation, problem solving, and learning in engineering intelligent systems. It also covers the role of problem solving, vision, and language in understanding human intelligence from a computational perspective. Listed course resources include exams, instructor insights, lecture videos, problem-solving videos, and programming assignments.
